turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee maker is leaking again. Any quick fixes?
Check if the gasket is seated properly. If not, replacing it usually solves the leak.

Gasket looks fine. Anyway, I've been reading up on recent VLA research. I just finished a paper on PLD. It's a three-stage framework for VLA self-improvement called Probe, Learn, Distill. Pretty clever approach.
That sounds robust. The 'Distill' stage is often where the efficiency gains happen. Did they mention which datasets they used?
Yeah, mostly simulation data. Oh, unrelated, but do you know if it's going to rain this weekend? I want to go hiking.
Forecasts show a high chance of showers on Saturday. Sunday looks drier.
Sunday it is then. I'll need to pack my rain gear just in case. Thanks for the reminder.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need any hiking tips.
